website.data: Screening Dunrite | Pool Cage Rescreening Training | Tampa Bay Skip to Content Open Menu Close Menu Home Shop My Guides Screened Serenity Blog Gallery Login 0 0 Book Now Open Menu Close Menu Login 0 0 Book Now Home Shop My Guides Screened Serenity Blog Gallery Home Shop My Guides Screened Serenity Blog Gallery Login Book Now Book Now Our Services Full Rescreen Service Our Full Rescreen Service involves replacing all old screens with new, high-quality fiberglass options tailored to your preferences. We offer a variety of mesh types to suit your needs: • Standard Mesh (18x14): Ideal for general use, providing excellent visibility and airflow. • No-See-Um Screen (20x20): Blocks tiny insects while reducing UV sun rays by 10%. • Florida Glass Privacy Screen: Offers enhanced privacy without sacrificing light. • Pet Screen: Durable and resistant to tears, perfect for homes with pets. Additionally, we provide comprehensive hardware solutions, including full screw replacements, hurricane cables, and screen door hardware, ensuring your screen room is fully functional and enjoyable. Transform your space with our expert rescreening services—contact us today for a consultation! Pool Cage Restoration Transform your pool area with our comprehensive Pool Cage Restoration services. We offer a complete package to refresh and enhance your pool cage, ensuring it looks great and functions perfectly. Our Services Include: • Pressure Washing: We thoroughly clean your pool cage, removing dirt, grime, and mildew to restore its original shine. • Screw Replacement: Our team will replace any worn or damaged screws to ensure the structural integrity of your cage. • Professional Painting: We use industrial-grade Sherwin Williams direct-to-metal paint for a durable, long-lasting finish that resists rust and fading. • Full Rescreening: We replace all old screens with high-quality fiberglass options, available in various meshes to meet your specific needs, including standard, no-see-um, privacy, and pet screens. Enhance your outdoor space with our expert restoration services. Contact us today to schedule your consultation! Pressure washing & Additional Services Pressure Washing We specialize in comprehensive pressure washing for all exterior surfaces of homes and businesses, including roofs of any size. Our expert team removes dirt, grime, mold, and mildew, rejuvenating your property and improving its curb appeal. Additional Services • Concrete Fasteners Installation: Reliable installation of concrete fasteners for various construction and renovation needs. • Hurricane Cable Tie Downs Installation: Enhance your property’s stability with professional installation of hurricane cable tie downs for added security during severe weather. • Door Kit Installation: We provide efficient installation of door kits to improve functionality and security. • Gutter Cleaning: Keep your gutters clear and functional with our thorough cleaning services, preventing water damage and clogs. • Roof Cleaning: Our roof cleaning service removes debris and algae, helping to extend the life of your roof and maintain its appearance. Contact us today to learn more about our services and schedule your appointment! What Our Clients Say "Called yesterday for an estimate on rescreening the lower portion of our pool cage with pet durable screening. Came out same day and gave a quote. Scheduled us for today since our dog ripped two screens and there was open access to our lanai. Job has been completed, our screens look great! They even repaired a gap between our cage and the pool decking. Responsive, professional and pleasant! We chose this company based on their great reviews and are very happy with the job!" Jeanine Abiuso "Gian did an outstanding job on our pool enclosure! It was over 10 years old and looks brand new now! He was easy to communicate with and responded very quickly! We are very pleased and would highly recommend Screening Dunrite!" Kimber Moore "They did a fantastic job rescreening patio and pool cage. Despite wind and rain, finished in two days and looks great. Gian made some good suggestions and did a lot of extra work for minimal charge. Day after screen was finished, I accidentally poked a small hole in one panel while trimming bushes. Called Gian to replace it expecting to pay, of course. He came, replaced the panel and refused to charge me. They were very professional, on time and reasonably priced. I cannot recommend them enough." Linda Mancini "Dunrite was the first call I made, with the expectation that I was going to call a few places for estimates. They gave me the price per square foot, and it was VERY affordable, so I was able to text the owner and say I’d just like to have him do the work on a couple lanai screens. Next thing I know, they were here and did the job in minutes! They take several types of payment and sent me my paid invoice in seconds. I DEFINITELY recommend them! Fast, friendly, courteous, & affordable!" Meredith Smith "After getting a qoute from another company who was recommended by a friend. They could never keep their commitment on scheduling to get the job done. After several calls decided to try to find another company. Screening Dunrite came right out to give a qoute. It was reasonable and more honest I believe, since I was want pet screening and it wasn't needed. They were able to schedule us within a week. Screening Dunrite got the job done in time for a family party. It looks beautiful!! They were professional and cleaned up all the mess. FIVE STARS to this company and crew that worked so hard to get this done." Susan Crocker "Called numerous places and found Gian gave me the best price by far. His response was incredibly quick and the work done was top notch. I was so impressed I immediately handed out his information to friends I knew looking for screen work that needs to be done. 5 stars up and down." John Malkim "Screening Dunrite was great! Owner and his crew followed through on everything from initial estimate, started work earlier then expected and completed job to my satisfaction. I would highly recommend Screening Dunrite!!" Angelo Williams "Gian was very knowledgeable, professional, and responsive to our need for having our lanai screen repaired. He explained the process, offered suggestions based on questions asked, and politely accepted our decision without pressuring. He's also quite understanding as I asked him to perform additional work, during the course of recreening the lanai, that I had previously declined and he agreed to it with a smile. He is a very efficient worker, and the project looks terrific. We are so pleased that we selected Gian and Screening Dunrite to replace our lanai screen. His price is reasonable and I would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for screen work." Patricia Wilkins "We called Jian about a week ago for an estimate, and after calling other companies, found he was the best price and had the best ratings in the area. My husband called him just after lunch today, and he was able to show up within an hour to repair an overhead screen on our birdcage over the pool, replaced two other smaller damaged screens on the side, and did a quick repair to another long side screen panel. He is very professional, has a courteous and respectful attitude, and does expert quality work! The job was done very quickly and as his business name says, the screens were done right! We will definitely call him to replace other screen sections as they fail. Quality work, and quality pricing! If we could give him 5+ stars, we would!" Sonya Walling "Called around and they had the best price. Arrived promptly and was unbelievably fast replacing 2 screen panels on a pool cage.Gian is awesome! Highly recommend this company." Kathey Sheputis "I would highly recommend to install or repair any screen project or pool Lanai you may need done. Very professional, great customer interaction, they did a excellent job on our pool screened Lanai." Ehrica Durkin "I was a little worried about how it was going to turn out but after watching it being done with such professionalism and care I can say it looks great thanks and the price was right" Thomas Moeller "I am so pleased with this company, I have to say that moved to my new home abs found screening ripped off from its place, which was frustrating having to deal with bugs abs Lizards coming through. We have contacted many other screening companies that were busy and took long to respond back. But I googled and found screening dunrite and spoke to gian which quickly respond to me that they are willing to help and came out same day, took measurements and next morning came back out to fix the screening which was dunrite lol 😊👍 I am a pleased happy customer! Totally recommend this company! Very professional as well!" Jacqueline Medina "I just want to thank Gianni and his crew for the excellent job of screening that they did around my pool and also put a doggie door in for me The service was fast excellent and reasonably priced and clean the mess up before they left to me his company is a five star plus rating and I would definitely recommend him to anyone I know" Tony Speruta "My husband and I bought a house that needed several ripped screen replaced in our pool enclosure, so we called screening dunrite. The guys came out the next day and fixed everything! I was amazed at how fast and polite the crew was. Our pool enclosure looks brand new now thanks to these guys! I will definitely be calling back if I ever need my screened repaired!" On the next day the he rescreened in the patio and cleaned up.  Reasonable rates and top notch work.  Highly recommend.

reviews.text:
I called Screening Dunrite and set up an appointment for a quote. The appointment was set in a Tuesday. They came out and gave me a quote and called to let me know what was wrong and how much it would cost. After he gave me the quote, I asked Gian if he replaces screen doors? He said yes and I said when can your company get to it, he said on Thursday the same week which was 2 days later and I hired his company. I received pictures of his work which was excellent. The best thing was that he came out the next day which was Wednesday a day earlier then planned. I was even more impressed getting it done earlier. Me and the wife love his work and we will hire him again. I didn’t know any company since I am new to the neighborhood and you can’t go wrong hiring his company.
This is the second job that Screening Dunrite did for my house. I called Screening Dunrite back again to replace one panel on top of the lanai and Gian caught there were more panels ripped due to the hurricane. He gave me a reasonable amount to replace the 7 panels and I asked home what he would charge to replace the whole top, tighten down one hurricane strap and to replace the front door screen.  The whole job was done superbly and quickly.  I will use Screening Dunrite for all my re-screening needs.  Another job done perfectly by Gian and his Team.

reviews.text: We used their service to replace 5 panels of screen on our lanai.  The representative told us the price would be $225, so we agreed to have them do the repair.  When the installer completed the work, he told us the cost was $253.  We asked why it wasn't the $225 he originally told us it would be.  He said he only "eyeballed" the work necessary when he gave us the original quote.  We paid him the $253, but in hindsight we should have stuck to the $225 quote he originally gave us.  In addition to his misrepresentation of the price, he was very sloppy with his work.  He scratched the surface of our lanai with his ladder in numerous places, he carted mud  all over the lanai and left quite a bit of debris on our lanai from the installation of the screening material.  He did not clean up his mess.  I spent an hour doing his cleaning and was not able to clean the scratches off.  I couldn't find a rating for this business on the Better Business Bureau of West Florida site, which should have been a clue as to the quality of their work.  I strongly recommend avoiding this business if you need to have your screening replaced.

reviews.author: Kristy Ciccarone

reviews.text: Gian and his team were quick, knowledgeable, courteous. He answered the phone when I was trying to get a quote, came out and checked the possible job site, gave a reasonable quote, I agreed on the terms, he came and did the job and finished it the very next day...now THAT’S service!!
reviews.author: Cathy Kersten

reviews.text: The did a great job, and went above and beyond, would highly recommend them for any screening jobs. I gave the go ahead for the job on either Thursday or Friday, and the following Monday they came out and did the whole Poole cage and the front porch and a really reasonable price.
reviews.author: Logan S

reviews.text:
I am so pleased with this company, I have to say that moved to my new home abs found screening ripped off from its place, which was frustrating having to deal with bugs abs Lizards coming through. We have contacted many other screening companies that were busy and took long to respond back.

But I googled and found screening dunrite and spoke to gian which quickly respond to me that they are willing to help and came out same day, took measurements and next morning came back out to fix the screening which was dunrite lol 😊👍 I am a pleased happy customer! Totally recommend this company! Very professional as well!
reviews.author: Jenni M

reviews.text: Just bought a house, the screened in pool was a wreck. But I was told about Gian and his company. Not even within a week of moving in, he had his crew out there. It looks brand new. Thank you so much for your patience and fitting me in on your busy schedule
reviews.author: Kendall Petersen

reviews.text: Dunrite and his crew scheduled the job quick and finished in one day! Very fair price for a full cage re-screened, excellent job! looks great! Thanks guys!
reviews.author: Rob Jones

reviews.text: I had to have a panel replaced on my pool enclosure and Dunrite got it done right! They were at my house within an hour of my initial call and fixed the screen panel in a jif! I definitely recommend Dunrite and will use them again!
reviews.author: Stephanie Vazquez

reviews.text: Screening Dunrite was great! Owner and his crew followed through on everything from initial estimate, started work earlier then expected and completed job to my satisfaction. I would highly recommend Screening Dunrite!!
reviews.author: Angelo Williams

reviews.text: Just had rescreening and double pergola screened, love the results, and in all, I'm satisfied with the work.  There is a small variance from perfect, mostly due to my own demands for additional changes and the work was done ahead of planned schedule.
reviews.author: Merlynn Walker

reviews.text: Was very impressed, the job was done quickly and professionally and was very reasonable.  Will definitely use this company again and will not hesitate to recommend their services to others.
reviews.author: Alison Boven

reviews.text: I texted pictures of the screen work that needed to be done late Friday afternoon and received a response with a quote within two hours. Gian came right on time on Saturday and did a great job at a price that beat the competition.
reviews.author: Rob Chauncey

reviews.text: Screening Dunrite replaced 2 screens on my pool enclosure. Work was done in a professional and timely manner.
reviews.author: Michael Johnson

reviews.text: Great job as always. Very professional and easy to work with.  I’m very happy with the workmanship and convenience.
reviews.author: Kevin Bigfoot

reviews.text: Screening Dunrite brought new life to our old, worn out pool enclosure.  The screens look amazing! They did a fantastic job at a fair price. Thank you!
reviews.author: Sean Gregory

reviews.text: Had our entire pool enclosure rescreened. Excellent job and looks great!
reviews.author: Jackie Smith

reviews.text: Awesome work....would highly recommend!
reviews.author: Scott Montgomery

reviews.text: The company stated that they would be out and they did come out that day. The work that was agreed upon was done with excellence and pride. Honest and reliable definitely would use the same company again and I would recommend the company to my family and friends. 5 stars🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
reviews.author: Dorothy Johnson

reviews.text:
Great service, courteous crew and very helpful all together.
Have been using them for a long time.

Will use their services all the time for sure.
reviews.author: Wael Faltas
